{{Top}}
The position of '''prime minister''' was a political title that existed among the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] species. [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] held the position of prime minister during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
